To start off with you earn quite quickly then it slows down further and further. If you watch loads of videos you can get more rewards but that is not for walking as the app is advertised for. Most of the rewards are for small discounts on items you don’t want anyway.

reviews.title: No rewards for game
reviews.text: I don’t recommend this app. The rewards steps are very small. The faster way to earn is by paying games. Small rewards are credited instantly, but rewards exceeding 1,000 coins get stuck in limbo; you have to submit request to have them credited and then wait several days. But it isn’t the main issue. I completed the final level of a game two days before the promotion ended. As usual, the results didn’t show up in the app on time. I took screenshots and sent them to customers support that same day to prove the level was finished and that I was 2,300 coins. However, two days later-once the promotion had ended-the final level was marked as not completed on time. Contacting customers support yielded no results. Now they want me to provide a video recording showing the successful completion of level. But that’s impossible to do, since the promotion has already ended. I don’t believe they can’t check the level completion time using my player ID. So, I’m inclined to think they are just stringing me along because they don’t want to give out the big rewards. So, I advise against wasting your time playing games on this app; you’ll just end up wasting time without receiving the rewards you earned.

reviews.title: Scam, not worth your time.
reviews.text: I have had this app for months, logging my steps nearly every single day. I've been dealing with glitchy issues of it not syncing properly with my fitness/health app and undereporting my daily steps (I have screenshots of this), so it's taken me longer than needed to finally reach 2K wards so I can redeem a gift card. I finally did so, after half a year of work, and they a) take several days to "process my gift card request" and then b) hit me with "sorry, your gift card request has been cancelled because you have a VPN on your phone." I use this to protect my privacy on the web as I also use this device for work and deal with confidential information, but have it always set to the city I live in. Now 6 months of work is just gone, no prior warning or heads up. Such a waste, a total scam, and not worth your time. They've enjoyed access to my data and sending me a million notifications for 6+ months, and I have been left with nothing. Don't download and waste your time on this data farming scam.

reviews.title: Pedometer not working sometimes
reviews.text: I quite like using this app, but I use it simultaneously with Moneywalk, which gives you much more coins and after maybe eighteen days using that (I record my meals and water intake etc as well) I had accrued £25 uber eats voucher. After using this app for nineteen days my steps are worth 0.65 pounds?! I’m in two minds about keeping this as what’s the point?! I Neve get plagued with ads whereas Moneywalk includes loads of ads but I ignore them when they come on. I like the panda but it’s not very profitable compared to Moneywalk. Like the cards tho!

reviews.title: Ottimo potenziale, ma il sistema di scambio va migliorato
reviews.text:
Trovo molto bella l'idea dello scambio di carte e io stessa mi sono appassionata fin da subito. Tuttavia, l'esperienza sta diventando frustrante. Cercare utenti a cui servano i propri doppioni in mezzo a una marea di profili è davvero dispendioso in termini di tempo.
Un altro aspetto snervante è la gestione delle carte vintage rare, come Donne del Mondo, Venus Williams, Natale, Galleria dei Mostri, Halloween, ecc. Nonostante le continue proposte di scambio, nessuno è disposto a cederle. Sono mesi che ho concluso i capitoli vintage delle città. Mi mancano circa 15 carte rare e una decina di quelle standard, ma collezionarle si sta rivelando un'impresa titanica e quasi impossibile.
Lascio questa recensione con la speranza che l'applicazione venga migliorata sotto questi aspetti. Completare i capitoli e fare scambi è molto soddisfacente, ma se l'idea iniziale doveva essere piacevole e appagante, al momento sta provocando solo frustrazione e nervosismo. Se la situazione non cambierà, purtroppo credo che disinstallerò l'app per cercare qualcosa di meglio.

reviews.title: I have an issue and can’t get support
reviews.text:
The app isn’t bad normally. You don’t get much for walking, you really need to play the games to earn any real money. I’ve been using it for around 11 months, and I’ve made $65. It’s not much, but was enough to buy a video game I wanted. I play daily but not too much so you could earn more if you play more. Now my issue is that I didn’t get an extra reward for something I completed, which is the first time. I tried their support through the app and I got nowhere. I didn’t know what else to do, so I came here to leave a bad review and hope they respond with an email address or something I can write to instead of the ai thing that doesn’t work. If they do and fix my issue I will update my review and give more stars.

Edit: They responded to this review literally saying to use the chatbot for help which is the exact thing I said doesn’t work. You can’t type any questions, it only gives you 2 options to pick and neither are relevant to my issue. After probably another 20 minutes of searching, on top of the 20 or so minutes it took me to find the chatbot, I found an email address. So I sent an email and we will see if someone actually answers, I kinda doubt it.

reviews.title: “We can’t reward you for this app”
reviews.text: Aside from getting money from walking you’re supposed to also be able to earn from downloading and playing games. I’ve tried this twice. I’ve clicked on the link provided by the WeWard app, get taken to the App Store and download the game. I then start playing the game for awhile. I come back to see if I’ve earned anything and all I get is “We can’t reward you for this app.” And it’s not like I can delete it and try again because once it’s been installed I’m ineligible to earn any rewards from the game. Oh and contacting support doesn’t work. You have to talk to some “chat bot” that gives you very limited options to pick from and even after you’ve gotten to submit a ticket support never responds to you. If you’re interested in the app, sure download it and check it out but don’t bother trying to get any “bonuses” from games or anything else they offer as I highly doubt it works just like the games.

reviews.title: Cards
reviews.text:
I do enjoy it, have lost some 30 lbs. since August when I started this  app. And cashed out for 150. My only complaint for now is the cards:
- I wish there was a way to get a specific missing vintage card directly from the app. I am missing Halloween 9 and summer 9. Users that have extras will ask for thousands of duplicate for those. Some are even selling for really money. I guess we ward is ok with this, the cards being sold for real money. 

Also , I can only get to 5 out of 7 daily walking cards. Tried emailing about if the other 2 can be moved from a busy street with no side walks to a neighborhood street where I already walk and was told no, it can’t be done. Even reported the unsafe cards or cards on private properties, and nothing was done. If card location can’t be manually adjusted, what is the point of having an option to report cards in the app. The more I interact with the app, the better for the app developers

reviews.title: Da evitare
reviews.text:
Era una app bella, invogliava a camminare, anche a camminare per raccogliere le carte e completare i capitoli dei luoghi. Era uno stimolo carino. Poi è diventata un gioco d’azzardo, in cui solo alcuni ricevono nuove carte fino addirittura (cosa successa oggi e documentata ) ad arrivare a chiudere un nuovo intero capitolo il giorno stesso dell’uscita con tanto di innumerevoli doppie. Creando una sorta di casta degli eletti alla quale gli altri devono rivolgersi per poter proseguire nel gioco e spesso ci si ritrova con vere e proprie richieste di danaro in cambio di una carta ( il sistema della app ti induce a chiudere i capitoli in fretta perché sennò diventano vintage e non si trovano più le carte)
La colpa è degli sviluppatori, poteva essere una cosa carina invece l’hanno trasformata in un gioco d’azzardo e malsano. L’ho fatta cancellare alle mie nipoti perché non è assolutamente adatta . E meno male che era nata per farci camminare e migliorare la nostra salute

reviews.title: Step count and distances are inaccurate
reviews.text: I live in a gated community according to Google maps the gate is 0.9 miles from my home I walk there and back every morning totaling 1.8 miles until I opened Google maps it was only counting half my steps to now 2/3rds of them and only tracking 1.2 miles of walking now it’s giving me 1.5miles. Still not counting all my steps…. I’m autistic I know exactly how many steps it takes to get from the hose to the gate. I’ve walked it way more times than necessary. Please fix the distance accuracy according to Google maps. (Maps says it’s 1 miles from my even on iPhone) the distance between cards is off by a lot! There’s no way are the steps that it’s saying to get from one card to the next are even possible unless you’re taking leaps for steps! I’m currently walking and have walked 1.3 miles and it’s saying .85 wth fix this mess if anything this app has discouraged me from walking not motivate me. I went from walking to the gate three times a day it just once because seeing this app BS makes me wanna cry.

reviews.title: Good for steps but not for rewards as it takes too long to get any WeWards!!!
reviews.text: First the stuff that I like about this app! I have been using it for 58 days now and I love collecting the cards it really motivates me to walk more! But as someone else said it’s really hard to collect them in a low internet area that’s the first bad thing! The second bad thing is how many WeWards that you get for your steps only 1 for 2500 steps that’s ridiculous most other walking  apps that I have looked at give you 1 point every 30 steps also I have come first in the leagues consistently which is mean’t to be 15 WeWard points so I should be on 900 points just for that but I’m only on just over 500 points I did use 300 but that’s only 800 points and all the stuff that I have done comes to much more! I also seem to be missing a week about 2-3 weeks in when I go and look at the history there’s a gap that shouldn’t be there! I did try to find some way of contacting the makers of this app but I couldn’t find any way to communicate with you about this so hopefully you will see this review :(

reviews.title: it IS a scam!!!
reviews.text: I’ve been in communication with Victoria from WeWard for 5 days now from using the in-app form and now email. I’ve been converting my steps every day for almost a year now and when I went to cash out $25 they tell me my transfer request was cancelled because I had manipulated my geolocation data. They claim to not know what time zone I’m in even though I’ve enabled my location services, given them my address, my driver’s license and my banking information. They now want me to submit an IRS form that cost $85 to even get! This is ridiculous, all for a step counting app! Huge waste of my time. They’re also going to respond to this review saying something generic like “Message us in the in-app form so we can resolve the issue with your account!” That is what brought me here, so don’t even fall for their “customer service”. Immediately going to tell anyone I told to sign up for this to delete their accounts. Scam Scam Scam.

reviews.title: Honest Review
reviews.text:
So…
First complaint, converting steps. But, this is the #1 complaint of all your users. If I open the app it should automatically know I’m active and want to convert and do it for me.  Also when I ran SoCal Ragnar I had ZERO service and couldn’t convert my steps. That means not coins I worked hard for and loss of my streak.  Not just that your ads when you try to convert are super annoying. . #2 Miss your streak and pay precious hard earned coins for a joker to keep the streak. LAME and not worth it. #3 I’m not a fan of the WeCards as well. I’m a runner and have this app open but don’t like running with my phone in my hand. Not just that it’s so hard to finish a collection. The amount of duplicate cards you get is bananas then you offered to trade is such a waste of time. I use the app because eventually I’ll be able to purchase something, but even your prizes are kind of lame.  Just wanted to give an honest opinion this app could be so much better.

reviews.title: WORST APP EVER!!!! SCAM!!!!
reviews.text: I’m absolutely furious right now!!! It’s no secret that it takes a decent amount of time to actually earn some money on this app. I have put in HOURS over the past couple of days trying to make a few bucks in the most agonizingly slow way possible. I need it so bad. Two of the games aren’t paying me what I’m owed after HOURS of playing them for the sole purpose to get paid. Then on top of that I just got kicked out of the THIRD survey that was supposed to pay me around 100 wards. Each time I was over 20 minutes into taking the survey. It had to be almost complete and I got absolutely nothing. There’s nobody I can talk to about it. I’m beyond upset. Obviously I need money if I’m willing to do such degradingly low paying surveys and games. Then to be cheated out of what is already offensive to be paid has me livid!!!! I was recommending this app!! Just last night I had my buddy download it. I feel taken advantage of, ripped off, lied to. Between what the games owe me and the surveys cheated me out of it equals AT LEAST 500 wards. Imagine putting in enough effort to earn 500 wards just to not receive them. We’re talking HOURS!!!!! I have nothing but animosity towards this app right now. Why wouldn’t I? I got cheated and basically stolen from. Absolutely disgusted right now. Unless they make things right, please, please use a different app. I wouldn’t wish what I just went through on anyone. Learn from my experience.

reviews.title: Customer service ignorance SCAM
reviews.text:
I don’t often write reviews but I cant not say this.
Its a SCAM. They try to hook you up with £ reward which again to convert to real money you need 3000wards, after collecting 1500 wards all payouts droped in half, it still shows for example 5000steps gives you 5wards but actualy I am getting only 2. 
I contacted customer service amonth ago, only response was from system that complaint received nothing else. 
They try to rob you of your wards in any possible way so you dont cash it out. Which again Im not sure how it will work with all the other nonsense so far.

reviews.title: Good but could use some improvements
reviews.text: I’ll start off with something I won’t deny I’m a pretty competitive person so I like to try and get all the rewards I can but it really annoys me having quests like get this exact amount of steps and I get around the amount it ones and the app just refuses to update my step count till I have another 1k steps so now I can’t claim my reward what’s the point of having ones like that if your app won’t even update but every once in awhile it’s so stupid and I have a watch that I use to track so it will tell me I’m at the exact amount so I’ll stand still for like 5 minutes trying to get it to update the step count but it refuses to also the daily walk counts like oh walk at this specific time I get they are trying to create variety but it makes no sense I have a set schedule like what do you mean walk between 6am and 8am makes zero sense like you can see my general times I’m active I work nightshift so wouldn’t it make sense to have more goals more aligned with that?

reviews.title: Plus on marche, moins on gagne…
reviews.text:
Après un premier commentaire déjà éloquent, il me semble nécessaire de préciser…
Auparavant, marcher donnait accès à des récompenses ! Plus tu marches, plus tu gagnes… Puis, l’arrivée des cartes a modifié la ligne de partage. Collectionner des cartes (fictives, faut il le rappeler !?) pour obtenir des points et, éventuellement, peut-être, sait-on jamais, des wards… En parallèle, plus tu marches, moins tu as de wards car tu es rapidement limité dans le nombre de wards que tu obtiens dans la journée avec un nombre de pas limité !
Les cartes, à une époque, tu en obtenais une ou deux tous les deux jours… Parfois presque quotidiennement… Aujourd’hui ?!?!?
Cela fait 11 jours et je n’ai obtenu qu’une seule carte ! Donc autant dire que la motivation pour continuer descend à zéro !! Il s’agit de trouver un équilibre qui n’existe pas ! Les cartes ne payent rien ! WeWard peut donner des doublons à profusion sans payer un centime !!! Une véritable arnaque pour des cartes, je le rappelle, fictives !!! Je vais aller sur « macadam » !! Au moins, pas de cartes et je gagne plus d’argent et plus vite…

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time and energy
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for nearly two years and managed to save up enough points to withdraw £15 twice. I was also close to reaching the £40 withdrawal when my account was suddenly suspended.  

I’ve contacted support, but no one has clearly explained what I supposedly did wrong. I’ve only been told there were “irregularities,” but without any proper clarification.  

I had a daily streak of 583 days, so it’s really frustrating to now be told my account is suspended after putting in that much time and effort. After two years of saving and staying consistent, it’s disappointing to feel like the £30 I managed to withdraw and the progress towards £40 has been taken away without a clear reason.  

Could someone please provide a specific explanation for the suspension and review my account?

reviews.title: Kicked Off Without Explanation
reviews.text: UPDATE: Anna, I can’t contact you via the in-app form, as it says my account has been banned. If there is any way to fix this which doesn’t involve contacting the same general contact me form then let me know. After reading all these negative reviews I am hesitant to invest any more time on this. // I’ve been using the app for 216 days and really enjoying it, until it stopped syncing my steps. When I reached out for help, I was ghosted for a while, then told vague language telling me I violated usage rules. I can’t get an explanation of how I violated them, just an AI-like generic response. I’ve read the rules, and can’t figure it out. All this once I’ve finally reached the point where I can cash out for a reward  - after not just walking, but also filling out numerous surveys, playing games, watching ads, and participating in the challenges. I’m not a person who writes negative reviews, but I feel taken advantage of. I was a real fan, WeWards, singing your praises to friends and making you a part of my everyday routine. I’m sad to feel betrayed by a brand I trusted by what feels like an algorithm’s determination.

reviews.title: Échange
reviews.text: Bonjour depuis l’instauration des échanges la première semaine tout allez bien mais ensuite alors plus des 3/4 des profils proposés ont des cartes dont on a besoin mais nous n’avons rien pour eux à échanger le peu de profil qui en ont pour nous refuse même des échanges à plus de 20 cartes contre une pour quoi je ne sais pas sachant qu’ils ont tout à gagner finalement. De toute manière dans une majorité des cas sa se solde par des refus peu importe l’échange ou alors carrément beaucoup ne répondent même pas du tout aux demandes émises alors mettre une limite de 20 échanges alors qu’il faut attendre 24h la réponse avec une limite de 10 échanges/semaine, on se retrouve assez bridés et parfois on arrive même pas du tout à effectuer justement les 10 échanges sur la semaine. bref ça c’est une chose mais mettre désormais un timing sur le bouton de « refresh » est limite aberrant et à quoi sa sert en plus hormis nous faire rester plus longtemps sur l’application sachant qu’on ne va pas passer notre vie à essayer d’échanger toute la journée pour avoir quasi que des refus .. le principe de base de l’application est bien de marcher pour faire des pas et non pas d’avoir le nez dans le téléphone pour finaliser des chapitres il manquerait plus que vous nous mettez aussi des pubs pendant les échanges tant qu’on y est ?

reviews.title: Suspended After Claiming Reward
reviews.text:
So I’ve been using WeWard for about a year now, and collecting the wards at the end of the day has been a part of my daily routine since then. I recently reached 2000 wards and claimed the reward for 25 dollars PayPal. Seemingly, it goes fine and will “take up to 15 days to arrive in my account”. 

Okay. Two days later I go to collect my wards of the day, and it opens to my account being suspended for “irregular activity, and that I could make a new account to continue earning, but the current one would have to be deleted”. No details on what exactly I had done or what I could’ve done to avoid it, so I contacted support explaining my falsely banned account. They got back in a few days reaffirming the suspension for “irregular activity” and that my account would not be unsuspended.  

I am writing this review to warn you not to waste your time with this app, the UI and everything seem decent and intuitive, but you’ll get suspended upon an attempt at collection.

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs, just another rip off
reviews.text:
Don’t waste your time.
The app it’s quite engaging, with lots of challenges and activities to keep you using it and watching as many neverending ads. If you’re after any excuse to stay active is ok, but forget about getting any money out of it.
After a few months and when I had accumulated over £20 they closed my account based on some “internal verification”, making me lose everything. When I requested an explanation they said that they didn’t have to give me one cause they knew why and that was enough.
As I said, avoid at all costs this rip-off.

reviews.title: 205 days to get £15
reviews.text: So, the title says it all really. I always walk 10,000+ steps a day so I thought I may as well earn whilst doing so. But, over 6 months to get £15?!?!?! Alongside the walking I have collected the “cards” every day as I walk, completed multiple surveys (many of which failed or rejected me after 5 minutes of answering questions!) and have watched thousands of adverts. I had to earn 3000 “wards” to get £15 and then had to give ALL my details including a photo of my driving licence to receive the money - I hope this data is secure! Nice idea for an app but I’m glad I can finally cash out and delete it ;-)

reviews.title: Delusione: Non più la app di una volta
reviews.text: Avevo questa app da molti anni e nei primi tempi l’ho ritenuta davvero onesta, l’unica forse che paga davvero per i punti raccolti. Poi dopo tanto tempo mi ritrovo il profilo sospeso senza motivo, a detta loro ho violato le loro regole di utilizzo (quali? Boh non mi è stato mai chiarito). Non ho mai falsificato il contapassi, né mai usato tool esterni per cambiare la geolocalizzazione, né altri sotterfugi. Ho solo contato passi, acquistato dai loro partner ufficiali, scaricato app per giocare e persino risposto a sondaggi, tutto inutile perché hanno deciso dall’oggi al domani di sospendere il mio account. Ho perso oltre 1500 wards e anni di raccolta punti. Sono convinta che sia stata una mossa strategica per evitare che io potessi raggiungere la soglia per riscuotere le ricompense. Veramente pessimi… mi avete deluso. Non scaricherò né utilizzerò mai più la vostra app. Non potete prendere in giro così le persone oneste.

reviews.title: Scam BEWARE
reviews.text:
I had been using this app for almost a full year, having earned premium status. I did all the things: walked, referred people, took surveys, downloaded games, watched literally over a thousand videos…and was close to cashing out for $150 in Venmo. And then I got a notification that I somehow “violated the terms” and in order to continue using the app, I need to delete my account, lose all my wards, and start over. 

I immediately emailed their support, asking for clarification and assuming it was an error. I got two very canned responses, both ignoring my request for clarification and they have, in essence, stolen all the wards I earned by simply following their rules. 

It’s crazy that they don’t have a way to review if there’s been an error or even remotely explain what happened. I still don’t have any idea what happened or if my account had been hacked but the shame is that I really enjoyed the app and was excited about being able to cash out.

I have looked at other reviews and found other people saying similar things; when they had been close to cashing out, they were suspended or banned. The responses they’ve sent to other complaints were to message within the app, however, when they suspend or ban an account, it’s impossible to message in the app.

TL;DR: they won’t pay out and their customer service is terrible. If you want to get paid for your activity, find another app.

reviews.title: Account got suspended
reviews.text: I’ve never actually made a review for any app before but I feel compelled to do it for this one. I only got to use the app for a little under a month. I think the app is great; it’s a good way to stay active and earn rewards. My sister recommended this app to me since I walk a lot for work and I walk even more at my schools campus. However, when I went to convert my steps last night, I opened the app and saw that my account got suspended over suspicions in fraudulent activity. I saw that a few people experienced something similar and the developer and its team said to reach out to their customer service for help. So I did that last night and detailed my concerns. And when I woke up this morning and went through my emails, all they said was that they are unable to restore my account. It’s frustrating since I’ve collected a lot of coins in the time I had my account. It seems like you’ll get your account suspended if you’re not actively walking on the streets and/or only in one location, no matter if it’s getting counted off your phone or Apple Watch. So if you plan on using this app, I’d say to be careful on when you convert your steps or else you might end up getting your account suspended.

reviews.title: Vi
reviews.text: I spent one year with the app, I run every day 7 to 10k, that means a bunch of steps every day, but when I was just a few steps away from my first £15 that option disappeared, what a coincidence isn’t, i think this app is rubbish, it’s just another way to have your data that’s more profitable for them, that the benefits you can ever claim. Use Pokémon go instead, at least you can have something and walk. I deleted the app because it’s not worth the effort!

reviews.title: Great promoter for health with inaccurate step counter
reviews.text:
The app's step counter is extremely inconsistent; it severely under counts steps or its lag time to update takes too long when on a time crunch for a challenge thus making the data unreliable for tracking fitness goals.
My wife and I have reached the top tier “Space Boots” and continue to be frustrated with the step count inaccuracy. We’ve tried swinging the phone, keeping it still, having it in our pockets, connecting our watch step counter with our phones and nothing seems to work. We get very frustrated when there is an accuracy step challenge and cannot get it cause it’s impossible to determine how many steps this App has actually counted…and it does not account for 1 step (if that’s all you need for that particular challenge)!
Please fix…!!!?

reviews.title: Fun Way to Track Steps But Absolutely A Scam outside of that.
reviews.text: Tracking steps on the app is fun, if only because I enjoy the streak feature as it motivates me to walk twice as much.  Do not waste your money on the premium feature.  There’s a lot of ads in the app and some of the side games like “spin the wheel” force you to watch an ad before using one of your 4 spins you get daily.  Even if you have premium… Unlike every other app, premium here doesn’t remove ads from the equation.  The spin the wheel game is rigged against the user.  My fiancée and I tracked my 4 spins a day for two weeks.  The reward seems to be set prior to “spinning.”  It’ll either spin really fast and just miss 10K or it’ll slow down and then speed up so you miss 10K.  Doesn’t seem to implement an actual RNG system.  The card collecting is cool but I’ve been screwed on completing sets even when I’ve purchased a few gold packs.  The cards are always in the same location.  They never move.  They just change.  I’ve collected the 7 around my neighborhood daily for a month and it’s repetitively boring on that front.

reviews.title: Decent Time-Killer, but Difficult to Earn
reviews.text:
I've been using WeWard for over three months now, but I've got a few things worth mentioning: 

1. The weekly step goals that the app sets are usually pretty high for me to obtain, which isn't an issue but it puts rewards just out of grasp even when I try to reach them. 

2. I quite dislike that I have been forced, not asked, by the app to use my Wards to refresh my streak. This has taken over 200 of my Wards and it's frustrating to not be given the option to opt out, especially when I don't make many Wards with the goals to begin with.

3. The lowest payout option that's even remotely achievable is put behind a paywall. You seriously need premium just to cash out $5?? Are you joking??

The fact that I've played for over three months and have yet to even break 500 Wards is frustrating, especially with the state of the streaks demanding refresh and not asking, and all the effort I've put into using the app and the fact that even if I DID hit 500, I can't get anything without either spending money (which is stupid when I'm trying to earn money) or by scraping up the singular Ward I get from walking every single day, if that. I really only keep it for the idle benefit, but even I'm starting to question if I'll ever get what I've earned. I'll try to come back and update if I do actually manage to cash out or I just delete the app lol.

reviews.title: Can be fun but not worth it money wise
reviews.text: The idea is good but it took me about 3 months to build up even £5 and the minimum you can draw back is £15. If you forget to convert your steps for the day you have to use 50 coins just retaining your streak. The donating to charity is a nice option and I did that a few times. I think it should have an auto upload of your steps personally as you sync your smart watch to it already. There are some nice touches and features such as the card collection but overall bad design in my opinion. I’m disappointed to have to leave.

reviews.title: Too many ads.
reviews.text: Too many ads. Especially annoying to have an Ad pop up every time when you click to convert your steps for the day. It’s exhausting. Not to mention the format of the ads. If anything WeWard has taught me patience because if you accidentally touch the ad while it’s playing it launches you over to the App store and if you indulge even a tiny bit in the Ads demo while it’s playing to can forget about the X you were planning to click and waste 5 minutes of your life. Exhausting. Just track my steps, allow me to convert my steps and go on with my day. Very Simple. Also the W coin reward system is bonkers. Become a triathlon athlete and you may earn enough coins in 5 years time to be able to redeem your hard earned coins for a measly $150, I believe that’s 10,000k coins. I average 7.5 miles a day each month for 3 months and only have 780 W coins. I think 180 at least was trying to get extra coins and waste my life on the mini games they offer. My actual exercise isn’t getting rewarded, which I feel like keeping up my exercise and motivating me to move around more was the whole point of this App. Boooooooo *throws tomato’s*
